i.norm:
Verifies that {@link MatchRatingApproachEncoder#isEncodeEquals(String, String)} recognises two phonetic spellings of the same Slavic surname as a match.

The two inputs are alternative transliterations of the surname commonly written as "Rosochowaciec" / "Rosokhovatsets". Although they are spelled differently, the Match Rating Approach algorithm should encode them to homophonous codes and therefore report them as equal.
Polish-style spelling of the surname (digraphs "ch" and "ie").
Anglicised transliteration of the same surname (digraphs "kh", "ho" and "ts").
